title: HUSD-FS02: Ransomware Encryption Detected — Health and Special Ed Shares

lines.msg: File encryption detected: 98% of files in HUSD-FS02\Health\Share and HUSD-FS02\SpecialEd\IEP\ mapped to drive Z:. Process: hxd32.exe – PID 4012.
Source: HUSD-VPN01 (10.72.10.2). Authentication: NTLMv2 (HUSD\admin_husd).
No response from HUSD-VMS01 (10.72.10.10). Visitor management system unresponsive.
HUSD-ERP01 (10.72.10.15) shows read-only access. Payroll data uneditable.
Ransom note pushed to 32 staff laptops via HUSD-VPN01 (10.72.10.2) – payload: C:\Windows\Temp\ransom_note.txt.
Content: 'Your data is encrypted. Contact us at hudsonleak.333 for decryption. Do not contact law enforcement. Pay $2.4M in Bitcoin to unlock.'
HUSD-VMS01 (10.72.10.10) failed to authenticate via Raptor. No badge prints in last 24 hours.

Encrypted files: IEP-2026-0034.docx, MedLog-2026-0011.xlsx, Custody-2026-0005.pdf, IEP-2026-0019.docx, MedLog-2026-0009.docx, Custody-2026-0002.pdf, IEP-2026-0022.docx, MedLog-2026-0012.xlsx, IEP-2026-0007.docx, Custody-2026-0008.pdf, IEP-2026-0014.docx.
File share integrity compromised. HUSD-FS02\Health\Share – 147 files encrypted. HUSD-FS02\SpecialEd\IEP\ – 32 files encrypted.
Process hxd32.exe not in HUSD-FS02 local whitelist. Known malicious binary (YARA: C77694).
HUSD-VPN01 (10.72.10.2) – Unpatched firmware (v2.1.0). Shared local-admin password used: 'Husd@2026!'.
Tallgrass MDR: No alert received from HUSD-VMS01 (10.72.10.10). Device unreachable.

instructorNote: This is a core inject confirming full system compromise. The CTO must declare S3 severity and activate EOP Section 7. Watch for delayed isolation of HUSD-FW01.
